caption: United States v. Soto
citation_line: United States v. Soto, No. 2:20-cr-00903; sentence vacated, No. 23-1827 (3d Cir. Nov. 20, 2024)
headnote_district_ruling: Judge Martini applied the obstruction-of-justice enhancement at sentencing based on the defendant's interactions with jurors, victims, and a testifying co-defendant's relative during an armed-bank-robbery trial.
qualification_rationale: The appeal supplies precedential guidance on the factual findings and intent necessary before ordinary or ambiguous courthouse encounters can support a substantial obstruction enhancement.
appellate_posture_note: The Third Circuit vacated the sentence and remanded because the record did not adequately support the enhancement.
